_comment: The game catalogue, extracted 2026-07-19 from the app repo's game definitions (app/lib/games/*/*_game_definition.dart, registered in game_registry.dart). Game names are proper nouns and are never translated; only the surrounding UI copy in src/locales/ is. 'functionality' is reference data in English: the page does not render it as prose, because that would put untranslated English paragraphs on six of the seven locales. players.perSide 2 means partnership play (2 teams of 2). Categories mirror the app's GameCategory, except that the blank scorecard is broken out of 'other' into 'free' because it is the one game that is always free.

games.name: Klaverjassen
games.functionality: Full calculating scorecard, roem and march handling, Amsterdam and Rotterdam variants, visual card rank and points chart in the rules

games.name: Jass
games.functionality: Calculating scorecard to 2500, Weis melds and trump multipliers, Schieber and Coiffeur variants

games.name: Belote
games.functionality: Bidding and trick scoring, Classic and Coinche variants

games.name: Whist
games.functionality: Tricks above the book of six, race to 5, Classic and Wiezen variants

games.name: Bridge
games.functionality: Contract scoring, Rubber and Duplicate variants

games.name: Euchre
games.functionality: Trump trick scoring, Classic and Stick-the-dealer variants
Contract bidding, race to 500 (lose at -500), Partnership and Three-handed variants

games.name: Spades
games.functionality: Bid and bag tracking, Nil bids, bag penalty every 10, Partnership and Solo variants

games.name: Cuarenta
games.functionality: Race to 40 with caidas, limpias and captures beyond 19

games.name: Mus
games.functionality: Four betting phases, Long (to 40) and Short (to 30) variants

games.name: Hearts
games.functionality: Standard, Omnibus, Spot and Cancellation hearts variants

games.name: Poker
games.functionality: Chip and pot tracking, four format variants

games.name: Blackjack
games.functionality: Chip ledger by default, plus a real dealer that deals and plays hands against you. Classic (Vegas), European, Atlantic City and Spanish 21 variants

games.name: Patience (Solitaire)
games.functionality: Full tap-to-move Klondike board, or score a physical deal. Klondike (1 and 3 card), Spider, FreeCell and Pyramid variants

games.name: Rummy
games.functionality: Meld and deadwood scoring, four family variants

games.name: Canasta
games.functionality: Race to 5000, Classic and Buraco variants on one engine

games.name: Jokeren
games.functionality: Double deck plus jokers, per-round penalty totals

games.name: Pesten
games.functionality: Round penalty scorecard

games.name: Toepen
games.functionality: To 15 and To 10 variants

games.name: Bollen
games.functionality: Prediction sheet where the card count climbs to a table-sized peak and back to 1. Base and +10 bonus variants

games.name: Uno
games.functionality: Race to 500, Classic, One round, Stacking and Seven-zero variants

games.name: Uno Flip
games.functionality: Own scorecard for the flipped deck, Classic and One-round variants

games.name: Briscola
games.functionality: Point capture on a 40-card deck, Classic and Cinque carte variants

games.name: Scopa
games.functionality: First to 11, Classic and Asso piglia tutto variants

games.name: Truco
games.functionality: Race to 12 with the bluffing ladder, Paulista and Mineiro variants

games.name: Skat
games.functionality: Bidding and 120-point declarer scoring, Standard and Bock variants

games.name: Doppelkopf
games.functionality: 48-card double deck scoring, Classic and Hochzeit variants

games.name: Schnapsen
games.functionality: 66-point race, Classic and Bela variants

games.name: Koenigrufen
games.functionality: 54-card tarock scoring, classic Koenigrufen and a simplified solo variant

games.name: Twenty-Five
games.functionality: 5 points a trick, Twenty-Five, Forty-Five and 110 variants

games.name: All Fours
games.functionality: Scores High, Low, Jack and Game to 14. Seven Up and Caribbean variants

games.name: Burro
games.functionality: Letter tally: five letters eliminates a player, last one standing wins

games.name: Loteria
games.functionality: Built-in caller that reveals all 54 tiles by name, plus a win tally. Full tabla, Line, Four corners and Center square variants

games.name: Yahtzee
games.functionality: Full calculating sheet with the 63+ upper bonus and extra-Yahtzee bonuses (100 each, Joker rule). Optional animated on-screen dice roller

games.name: Dudo
games.functionality: Elimination tracking, Classic (aces wild) and No-wild-aces variants

games.name: Chess
games.functionality: Live 8x8 board with full legal-move enforcement (check, mate, stalemate, castling, en passant, promotion), Resign and Draw, plus a three-level computer opponent on a practice screen. Session tally of games won

games.name: Checkers
games.functionality: Live 8x8 board, forced and multi-jump captures, king promotion, three-level computer opponent. Captures-forced and Captures-optional variants

games.name: International draughts
games.functionality: Live 10x10 board, flying kings, compulsory maximum capture, tap-out capture sequences with a step-back control

games.name: Connect Four
games.functionality: Live 7x6 board where a tap drops a disc and gravity picks the row. Discs differ by shape, not colour alone

games.name: Tic Tac Toe
games.functionality: Live tappable 3x3 board with auto win and draw detection, session tally of games won

games.name: Sudoku
games.functionality: Live 9x9 board with a seeded generator that guarantees a unique solution, five difficulty tiers (Beginner to Evil), pencil notes and hints, scored on solve time plus penalties

games.name: Backgammon
games.functionality: Hotseat board with dice, hits, bar re-entry and bearing off. Wins score 1, gammon 2, backgammon 3. Standard and Nackgammon openings

games.name: Dominoes
games.functionality: Hotseat pass-and-play board with matching open ends, draw and pass. Block, Draw and All Fives variants

games.name: Rummikub
games.functionality: Per-round tile scoring for the physical set

games.name: Cluedo
games.functionality: Private detective notepad on your own device: 21 rows (6 suspects, 6 weapons, 9 rooms), an envelope column that cycles blank / ruled out / has it, and a free notes column

games.name: Darts
games.functionality: Leg scoring with an on-screen dartboard for entering the throws you made. 501 and 301 variants

games.name: Bowling
games.functionality: Real ten-frame scoring: strikes carry the next two balls, spares the next one, tenth frame gets a third ball. Frames pending a bonus stay blank, like a paper sheet

games.name: Kegelen
games.functionality: Nine-pin scoring where every felled pin is one point and the throw count is open-ended. Volle bos and Afruimen variants

games.name: Midgetgolf
games.functionality: Strokes per hole on a 9 or 18 hole course

games.name: Tennis
games.functionality: Games, sets and match scoring. Best of 3 and Best of 5 sets

games.name: Padel
games.functionality: Golden point and With-advantage variants

games.name: Table tennis
games.functionality: Best of 3, 5 and 7 variants

games.name: Blank scorecard
games.functionality: Always free, no purchase. Score any game at all: name the players, add rounds, pick Highest total wins or Lowest total wins
